# NetDiag Twin 0.5.4

This candidate fixes diagnostics and Overview layout defects and refreshes the
dependency stack. Release validation is still in progress; this file is not a
publication or installation receipt.

- Keeps all five Overview cards the same width when the available space does
  not divide evenly, and moves Overview content correctly when scrolling a
  short window.
- Reads macOS interface totals from netstat link rows, including loopback and
  tunnel interfaces with blank link-layer addresses. Address aliases no longer
  cause valid collection to fail or shift numeric columns.
- Reports unsupported timeout, retry, DNS, and TLS event metrics as fallbacks
  in system-counter and pcap collection. Interface error ratios are estimated
  loss evidence, and latency warnings disclose the actual placeholder value.
- Updates stable Rust and Python dependencies, desktop rendering and native-menu
  integrations, packet parsing, archive output, and Sparkle 2.9.6. Keeps the
  latest compatible ndarray, sprs, and matchit versions required by upstream
  libraries; retains the audited argmin compatibility patch.
- Corrects the short report's application entry points and example-data claims.
- Reads historical window summaries without inventing missing P50/P99 values;
  chart gaps represent unrecorded observations. Accepts legacy absolute artifact
  paths only within their current artifact root and run directory.
- Keeps explicitly selected artifact directories after restarting the bundled
  app. Shows an unconfigured API form without a false Keychain error.
- Prevents compact English diagnosis and status text from overlapping, and
  keeps natural text spacing in the rule/ML comparison cards.
- Removes mandatory independent release approval; automated validation,
  deployment restrictions and artifact verification remain release requirements.

Native platform CI, populated macOS interface acceptance, Developer ID signing,
notarization, installation, and old-version update evidence remain release
requirements. Windows mutation limitations, read-only tc/netem behavior, and
the pending real-device validation status are unchanged.
